subject: Novus POC: access, success criteria, timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@novushealth.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@novushealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Novus POC: access, success criteria, timeline
Attachments: novus-poc-plan-v1.pdf

Hi Alex / Priya —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC started for Novus: 

TL;DR: proposed 3-week POC to validate latency, cost, and accuracy on the EHR summarization use case. Kickoff target: Tuesday, July 6, 10:00 AM PT.

Scope
- Ingest up to ~10k anonymized notes (sample set) for intent/summary evaluation
- Run a mix of short queries (1-2 prompts) and longer context summarization
- Test performance with a small concurrent load (10 qps) to validate p95 latency and stability

Success criteria (suggested)
- p95 generation latency < 200ms on our hosted SKU for the target prompt mix
- Mean ROUGE-L / human-rated quality >= your baseline (we'll align on eval set)
- Cost envelope: target <= $X per 1M tokens (we'll produce cost estimates after initial run)

Roles & ownership
- Novus: provide sample data, IT contact for SSO/IP allowlist, acceptance criteria owner
- Redwood: provide POC environment, test API key/SSO invite, POC plan & evaluation harness (attached)

Access / provisioning asks
1) IT contact & details for SSO (Okta SAML) or service account provisioning
2) IP ranges you can allowlist (we can provide our egress IPs if you prefer allowlisting)
3) If you want a short-lived API key for initial validation, confirm authorized account(s)

Attachments: I attached "novus-poc-plan-v1.pdf" - includes milestones, data checklist, and evaluation plan.

Proposed next steps
- Confirm kickoff date/time (proposed July 6, 10:00 AM PT)
- Share IT contact + preferred access method (SSO vs API key)
- Share sample data (anonymized) or confirm when we'll get it

If that all looks good I can loop in Vivek (SE) to create the environment and hit the ground running.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference.

From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@novushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@novushealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novus POC: access, success criteria, timeline

Thanks Marissa — really appreciate the clear recap. Priya (cc'd) is our IT lead and will own the SSO/IP side. A few quick answers and asks from our side: 

- Timeline: July 6 kickoff works for us; three-week window is fine as a target.
- IT: Priya is Okta admin. We prefer SAML-based SSO for our users but can accept an initial test API key for automation work.
- IP allowlist: we'll need the IP block(s) you want us to add; can you provide a short list?
- Data: we'll send an anonymized sample set by EOD Thursday.
- Security: we have a short vendor security questionnaire - can you point me to the contact for that?

One question: for the POC eval, will you provide the eval harness and scoring scripts so we can run locally against our ground truth? Also confirm whether the trial environment will store data locally in your instance or if it will be isolated per our account.

If you can provide the SSO metadata or a short-lived API key, we can start the allowlist and invite process.

Best,
Alex Torres
Director, Data Engineering | Novus Health
alex.torres@novushealth.com | +1 206-555-0199

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@novushealth.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@novushealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novus POC: access, success criteria, timeline
Attachments: novus-poc-setup-instructions.md, redwood-technical-reqs.xlsx

Hi Alex / Priya —

Looping in a couple of details to get your IT team unblocked. I created a short-lived API key for initial validation while we set up SAML SSO:

- Test API key: redwood_test_novus_abc123 (expires in 14 days)
- Base URL: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

Please treat the key as sensitive; we'll rotate it when you move to a longer-lived service account. For quick smoke tests:

curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer redwood_test_novus_abc123" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-small","prompt":"Summarize: <note_text>","max_tokens":150}'

IP allowlist (recommended egress ranges):
- 52.12.34.0/24
- 34.21.16.0/24

SSO / Okta notes:
- We support SAML 2.0. If Novus uses Okta we can accept an IdP-initiated flow or SP-initiated. Send the IdP metadata URL or an exported XML and we will configure on our side.
- If you want us to send invites we can create SCIM service account(s) for user provisioning - let us know your preference.

Attachments: I attached a one-page setup guide (novus-poc-setup-instructions.md) and a matrix of technical requirements (redwood-technical-reqs.xlsx). Also linking the POC checklist here: https://drive.google.com/novus-poc-plan

Security questionnaire: please send the doc to security@redwood.com - our security team will respond within 48-72 hours.

Let me know if you'd like me to open a short lived VPN tunnel or provide an alternative if the allowlist isn't possible.

Thanks - looking forward to kickoff.
Vivek
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Novus POC: access, success criteria, timeline

Thanks Alex / Priya - appreciate the quick responses. Confirming next steps:

- Kickoff: Tuesday, July 6, 10:00 AM PT (we'll send calendar invite shortly; Rachel will lead the kickoff agenda).
- IT action: Priya to provide IdP metadata or confirm you want a test API key. Vivek shared a short-lived test key (redwood_test_novus_abc123) - please use that for initial validation and let us know when you've completed allowlisting.
- Data: Novus to share anonymized sample set by EOD Thursday.
- Security: Alex - please send the questionnaire to security@redwood.com; our security team will pick it up.

Rachel, looping you in to coordinate the kickoff agenda and invite. Vivek, please confirm when the SSO config is complete and whether you need any additional Novus contacts.

Thanks all - excited to get started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
